Name: DoNotEatMyCrops
Author: hyanggueot
Description: The DoNotEatMyCrops mod for StardewValley(1.6ver) is designed to protect your crops from being eaten by crows. In the base game, crows can sometimes destroy your crops if they are not properly protected. This mod prevents that from happening by altering the game’s internal mechanics to ensure that crows no longer damage your crops.

Manifest.Name: DoNotEatMyCrops
Manifest.Description: Prevents crows from spawning on the farm.
